title: sutra ratchet CLI: release + list
description:
CLI subcommands on the sutra binary: `sutra ratchet release <constraint-id> --rationale "..."` (rationale required; optional --by, default from git config user.name) sets released_at/released_by/release_rationale on the registry row — row kept forever, audit trail is the point. Error clearly if id unknown or already released. `sutra ratchet list` shows active + released ratchets: id, name, severity_floor, registered_at, released info.

Deliberately CLI-only — NOT an MCP tool action (decision in sutra/223: normative human boundary; agents live in MCP). Do not add ratchet actions to src/tools/constraints.rs beyond read-only status display (that's sutra/246).

Design: sutra/223 implementation_plan. Tests: release sets fields + preserves row, double-release errors, unknown id errors, list output includes released history.
